## R Markdown
```{r}
data<-data %>% 
  mutate(
    weight=case_when(
      SDDSRVYR=="1"|SDDSRVYR=="2"~(2/5)*WTSPP4YR,
      SDDSRVYR=="3"|SDDSRVYR=="4"|SDDSRVYR=="5"~(1/5)*WTSC2YR,
      SDDSRVYR=="7"~(1/3)*WTSC2YR,
      SDDSRVYR=="9"|SDDSRVYR=="10"~(1/3)*WTSB2YR
    )
  
)
dim(data)

#death due to CVD vs all other people; create CVD_death variable
data  <- data %>%
  mutate(CVD_death = case_when(
    ucod_leading==1~1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

#death due to cancer vs all other people; create cancer_death variable
data  <- data %>%
  mutate(cancer_death = case_when(
    ucod_leading==2~1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

#Drop those with weight=NA
data_1999_2008=data %>% filter(!is.na(weight)&(SDDSRVYR %in% c(1,2,3,4,5)))
dim(data_1999_2008)
data_2011_2018=data %>% filter(!is.na(weight)&(SDDSRVYR %in% c(7,9,10))) 
dim(data_2011_2018)


```

```{r create survey object for 1999_2008}

library(survey)

analysis_1999_2008 <- svydesign(data=data_1999_2008, id=~SDMVPSU, strata=~SDMVSTRA, weights=~weight, nest=TRUE)
#i can add this as an indicator variable to avoid subsetting for each criteria: inAnalysis= (RIDAGEYR >= 18 & eligstat == 1 & permth_exm!=0 & !is.na(URXUCR)&weight!=0)
#weights have been calculated and applied, now we can subset the survey data

table(analysis_1999_2008$variables$mortstat, useNA="always")
dim(analysis_1999_2008)

#drop those not eligible for linkage
mort_eligDesign<-subset(analysis_1999_2008, eligstat == 1) #this automatically 
#removes younger than 18 because they are not eligible
dim(mort_eligDesign)
#no missing mortality status
table(mort_eligDesign$variables$mortstat, useNA="always")
subset.elig.18 <- subset(mort_eligDesign, RIDAGEYR>= 18)
dim(subset.elig.18) #13881

#drop those with missing follow up
#6 people have no follow up time from exam, we can exclude them here# (note: current written table1 includes them)
sum(subset.elig.18$variables$permth_exm==0)
subset.elig.18.followed=subset(subset.elig.18, permth_exm!=0)
dim(subset.elig.18.followed) #13875

#drop those with zero weight
subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight=subset(subset.elig.18.followed, weight!=0)
dim(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight) #13125

#creatinine missingness
sum(is.na(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight$variables$URXUCR)) / nrow(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight) * 100 #about 1% of people
sum(is.na(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight$variables$URXUCR)) #159 people

subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%
  summarise(
    na_count = sum(is.na(URXUCR)),
    total_count = n(),
    percent_missing = (na_count / total_count) * 100
  )
#drop those with missing creatinine
subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight.creatinine_1999_2008=subset(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight, !is.na(URXUCR))
dim(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight.creatinine_1999_2008)
```


```{r create survey object for 2011-2018}

library(survey)

analysis_2011_2018 <- svydesign(data=data_2011_2018, id=~SDMVPSU, strata=~SDMVSTRA, weights=~weight, nest=TRUE)
#i can add this as an indicator variable to avoid subsetting for each criteria: inAnalysis= (RIDAGEYR >= 18 & eligstat == 1 & permth_exm!=0 & !is.na(URXUCR)&weight!=0)
#weights have been calculated and applied, now we can subset the survey data

table(analysis_2011_2018$variables$mortstat, useNA="always")
dim(analysis_2011_2018)

#drop those not eligible for linkage
mort_eligDesign<-subset(analysis_2011_2018, eligstat == 1) #this automatically 
#removes younger than 18 because they are not eligible
dim(mort_eligDesign)
#no missing mortality status
table(mort_eligDesign$variables$mortstat, useNA="always")
subset.elig.18 <- subset(mort_eligDesign, RIDAGEYR>= 18)
dim(subset.elig.18) #13881

#drop those with missing follow up
#6 people have no follow up time from exam, we can exclude them here# (note: current written table1 includes them)
sum(subset.elig.18$variables$permth_exm==0)
subset.elig.18.followed=subset(subset.elig.18, permth_exm!=0)
dim(subset.elig.18.followed) #13875

#drop those with zero weight
subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight=subset(subset.elig.18.followed, weight!=0)
dim(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight) #13125

#creatinine missingness
sum(is.na(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight$variables$URXUCR)) / nrow(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight) * 100 #about 1% of people
sum(is.na(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight$variables$URXUCR)) #159 people

subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%
  summarise(
    na_count = sum(is.na(URXUCR)),
    total_count = n(),
    percent_missing = (na_count / total_count) * 100
  )
#drop those with missing creatinine
subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight.creatinine_2011_2018=subset(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight, !is.na(URXUCR))
dim(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight.creatinine_2011_2018)
```

```{r URXOP1 create exposure variable for 1999-2008 survey object}
#drop 
analysis_URXOP1_crt<- subset(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight.creatinine_1999_2008, !is.na(URXOP1))
dim(analysis_URXOP1_crt) #DAP 1: 12798

#create creatinine adjusted exposure (O'Brien's method)
# take the log of creatinine variable

analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables=analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>% 
  mutate(logcreatinine=log(URXUCR))

#check percent missing on bmicat: about 1%, has missing category
summary(subset.elig.18.followed.nonzeroweight.creatinine$variables$bmicat)

# Fit the regression model and store predicted values
analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables=analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>% 
  mutate(logpredicted = predict(lm(logcreatinine ~ RIDAGEYR+sex+race+bmicat+SDDSRVYR, data=analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables)))
View(analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>% select(logcreatinine, logpredicted))


#create variables to get creatinine adjusted
analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables=analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>% 
  mutate(pC=exp(logpredicted),
         Cratio=URXUCR/pC,
         URXOP1_crt=URXOP1/Cratio)

# View the updated dataset
View(analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>% select(SEQN, logcreatinine, logpredicted, pC, URXUCR, Cratio, URXOP1, URXOP1_crt))

head(analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>% select(SEQN, URXOP1_crt))
max(analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables$URXOP1_crt)
# analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>% 
#   group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>% 
#   summarize(max_URXOP1_crt = max(URXOP1_crt, na.rm = TRUE))

#create the cycle-specific quartiles
analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables <- analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%
  mutate(
    quartile = as.numeric(
      cut(
        URXOP1_crt,
        breaks = quantile(URXOP1_crt, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE),
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        labels = FALSE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

table(analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables$quartile)

quartile_check <- analysis_URXOP1_crt$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR, quartile) %>%  # Group by cycle & quartile
  summarise(
    count = n(), 
    min_URXOP1_crt = min(URXOP1_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_URXOP1_crt = max(URXOP1_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%                                # Regroup to calculate percentages
  mutate(percentage = round(100 * count / sum(count), 2)) %>%  # Calculate % within each cycle
  arrange(SDDSRVYR,quartile) %>%   # Sort for easier comparison 
ungroup()

quartile_check #should be 25% per cycle and quartile level, may need to use this: detach("package:plyr", unload = TRUE) to allow for summarize and coun functions 

#variables on other files use analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont, thus we create this dataset so we don't have to change everything
analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008<- analysis_URXOP1_crt
analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008$variables <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008$variables %>%
  dplyr::select(-URXOP1)  # Drop the URXOP1 column to ensure no mix up in analysis
dim(analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008) 
#DAP1 12798 by 911
#DAP2 12801 by 911, 
#DAP3 12817 by 911, 
#DAP4 12755 by 911,
#DAP5 12802 by 911,
#DAP6 12690 by 911

```

```{r create exposure variable for 2011-2018 survey object}
analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables=analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>% 
  mutate(logpredicted = predict(lm(logcreatinine ~ RIDAGEYR+sex+race+bmicat+SDDSRVYR, data=analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables)))
View(analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>% select(logcreatinine, logpredicted))


#create variables to get creatinine adjusted
analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables=analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>% 
  mutate(pC=exp(logpredicted),
         Cratio=URXUCR/pC,
         URXOP4_crt=URXOP4/Cratio)

# View the updated dataset
View(analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>% select(SEQN, logcreatinine, logpredicted, pC, URXUCR, Cratio, URXOP4, URXOP4_crt))

head(analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>% select(SEQN, URXOP4_crt))
max(analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables$URXOP4_crt)
# analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>% 
#   group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>% 
#   summarize(max_URXOP4_crt = max(URXOP4_crt, na.rm = TRUE))

#create the cycle-specific quartiles
analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables <- analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%
  mutate(
    quartile = as.numeric(
      cut(
        URXOP4_crt,
        breaks = quantile(URXOP4_crt, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE),
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        labels = FALSE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

table(analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables$quartile)

quartile_check <- analysis_URXOP4_crt$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR, quartile) %>%  # Group by cycle & quartile
  summarise(
    count = n(), 
    min_URXOP4_crt = min(URXOP4_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_URXOP4_crt = max(URXOP4_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%                                # Regroup to calculate percentages
  mutate(percentage = round(100 * count / sum(count), 2)) %>%  # Calculate % within each cycle
  arrange(SDDSRVYR,quartile) %>%   # Sort for easier comparison 
ungroup()

quartile_check #should be 25% per cycle and quartile level, may need to use this: detach("package:plyr", unload = TRUE) to allow for summarize and coun functions 

#variables on other files use analysis_URXOP4_crt.imputed.cont, thus we create this dataset so we don't have to change everything
analysis_URXOP4_crt.imputed.cont_2011_2018<- analysis_URXOP4_crt
analysis_URXOP4_crt.imputed.cont_2011_2018$variables <- analysis_URXOP4_crt.imputed.cont_2011_2018$variables %>%
  dplyr::select(-URXOP4)  # Drop the URXOP4 column to ensure no mix up in analysis
dim(analysis_URXOP4_crt.imputed.cont_2011_2018)
```

```{r DMP, all cause, 1999-2008}

analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008$variables=analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008$variables %>% droplevels()

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008 <- svycoxph(
  formula = Surv(permth_exm, mortstat) ~ as.factor(quartile)+ RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
  design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008)%>% tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) 

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008.pval <- svycoxph(
  formula = Surv(permth_exm, mortstat) ~ quartile+ RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
  design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont_1999_2008)%>% tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) 

# #interaction
# all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.pval.strat_cycle_het<- svycoxph(
#   formula = Surv(permth_exm, mortstat) ~ quartile*Strat_cycle+RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
#   design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont)
# 
# View(all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.pval.het$table_body)

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008.pval_numbers=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008.pval$table_body %>% filter(term=="quartile") %>% select(p.value)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008.pval_numbers

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_numbers=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008$table_body %>% filter(term=="as.factor(quartile)2"|term=="as.factor(quartile)3"|term=="as.factor(quartile)4") %>% 
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>% 
  mutate(
    Metabolite="DMP",
    Outcome="All cause",
    Survey_Cycles="1999-2008",
    HR=round(estimate, digits=2),
         CI_low=round(conf.low, digits=2),
         CI_high=round(conf.high, digits=2),
    HR_CI=paste0(HR, " (", CI_low, ", ", CI_high, ")")) %>% 
  select(Metabolite, Outcome, Survey_Cycles, term, HR_CI)

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_numbers

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_final=bind_cols( all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_numbers, all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008.pval_numbers)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_final

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_final_wide=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_final %>% pivot_wider(names_from=term, values_from=HR_CI) %>% select(Outcome, Metabolite, Survey_Cycles, `as.factor(quartile)2`,`as.factor(quartile)3`,`as.factor(quartile)4`, p.value)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj.1999_2008_final_wide
```
